claims.text: Same primitives as ``daedalus.budget._BudgetLock`` and ``runs/council/room.py``'s ``_RoomLock`` (``msvcrt`` on Windows, ``fcntl`` on POSIX), independently written here -- both of those are private to modules this file does not own.

claims.text: Same fail-closed posture as the budget lock, and for the same reason: two promotions racing into one integration worktree is exactly the shared-mutable-state hazard this whole module exists to close, just moved one layer up.
claims.why: The budget lock is not in this chunk; cannot verify fail-closed posture or the hazard description.

claims.text: An unobtainable lock RAISES; it never silently proceeds unserialised.
claims.why: The __enter__ method raises PromotionUnavailable if lock cannot be acquired within timeout.

observations.what: _PromotionLock uses fcntl/msvcrt for cross-process locking, with a timeout and retry loop.
_hardened_env sets GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT and removes several environment variables to prevent Git from using external programs or config.
_read_gitdir_pointer is declared but its body is not present in this chunk (chunk ends after docstring).
